pages.text: The Magic Center GUI provides several controls to fine-tune your ritual setup.$(br2)$(bold)Circle Type Toggles$() - Each circle type (Attack, Defense, Regeneration) has an On/Off switch. Turn off types you don't want to use without breaking the circles.

$(bold)Player Blacklist$() - Add players by name to prevent them from receiving circle effects.$(br2)$(bold)Controller Whitelist$() - The owner may grant other players control of settings and permission to withdraw spirit-stone fuel. Controllers cannot grant access to others or dismantle the center.$(br2)$(bold)Mob Filters$() - Choose which mob categories are affected.

Anyone may inspect a center and donate spirit stones, but only the owner, an operator, or a whitelisted controller may remove fuel. Only the owner or an operator may dismantle the center.$(br2)All settings and access lists are saved with the center.
